# PlayArena

> PlayArena is a browser-based gaming platform at https://playarena.co.in. Visitors can play free HTML5 games instantly in a web browser without downloading software. The library includes puzzle, arcade, action, racing, sports, adventure, and casual games.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://playarena.co.in/): Discover featured, trending, and free online games.

- [Games](https://playarena.co.in/games): Browse the complete PlayArena game library. Games can be filtered by category with the `category` query parameter.

- [Leaderboard](https://playarena.co.in/leaderboard): View top players and high scores across featured games.

- [Spin the Wheel](https://playarena.co.in/spin-wheel): Use the PlayArena rewards wheel to unlock bonuses and rewards.

- [Play and Earn](https://playarena.co.in/play-and-earn): Access the PlayArena rewards experience.

- [Favourites](https://playarena.co.in/favourites): Access saved favourite games.

## Games

- [Play a Game](https://playarena.co.in/play/{gameName}): Game detail and playable page. Replace `{gameName}` with the Name of a game from the Games library.

- Game categories include 2 player, puzzle, action, sports, racing, arcade, adventure, and casual games.

- Games are designed to run directly in modern web browsers, with no download required.
